concerns.description: Link text pulled over but not hyperlinked
concerns.analysis: On page 34 of the source PDF, several project titles under the 'NASCIO Award Recipients and Finalists' section are clickable hyperlinks (e.g., 'When Minutes Mattered: Automated COVID-19 Reporting System Saved Hospitals’ Time and Reduced Administrative Burden'). While a truncated artifact of the link appears orphaned at the end of the page array, the actual inline text the user reads has been flattened to plain text.
